title: Baermann Funnel Extraction
author: Casey A Schlenker
materials: Cover all Baermann funnels with a plastic Uline

steps.title: Weigh soil sample
steps.instruction: Weigh out 50 g of soil into a weigh boat.

steps.title: Prepare funnel with tissue paper
steps.instruction: Place a piece of tissue paper on top of the Baermann funnel apparatus.

steps.title: Add soil onto filter paper
steps.instruction: Place the weighed, sieved soil onto a filter paper positioned over the funnel.

steps.title: Saturate soil with DI water
steps.instruction: Fill the Baermann funnel with deionized (DI) water using a DI water bottle until the soil is saturated but not fully submerged.

steps.title: Monitor water level at set times
steps.instruction: At the 24 h and 48 h marks, inspect the soil and add DI water if the level has decreased to prevent drying.

substeps.instruction: Check water level at 24 h and add DI water if needed
Check water level at 48 h and add DI water if needed

steps.title: Collect nematodes after incubation
steps.instruction: At 72 h, empty the funnel over a 25 µm mesh sieve to capture nematodes.

steps.title: Transfer nematodes to fixative tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the nematodes retained on the sieve into a labeled centrifuge tube containing a hot fixative (as prepared by Casey A. Schlenker).

steps.title: Count nematodes under microscope
steps.instruction: Count the entire sample at 50× magnification using a dissecting microscope.

steps.title: Determine soil moisture content
steps.instruction: Collect the soil remaining on top of the Baermann funnel, dry it, and weigh to calculate gravimetric soil moisture content.
